primary_contract: Synthetic costing-study tutorial suite using public-safe fixtures and documentation examples
support_scope: Public-safe documentation and synthetic fixture coverage for costing-study workflows that connect NWAU outputs to NEP, observed costs, AHPCS/NHCDC concepts, and stream-level benchmarking. The track covers tutorial text, caveats, fixture provenance, and docs-site navigation; it does not certify official IHACPA outputs, local funding decisions, or patient-level costing data.

gap_register.gap: Tutorial examples are documentation-level and synthetic; they are not official IHACPA costing-study submissions or policy decision tools.
gap_register.rationale: The acceptance criteria require reproducible tutorials and synthetic data, not official costing approval or confidential patient-level data.

gap_register.gap: Executable notebook/runtime coverage is limited to checked docs and fixture contracts rather than end-to-end notebook execution.
gap_register.rationale: The repository currently validates the tutorial surface and fixture provenance; full notebook execution should remain a follow-on docs runtime gate.

description: Add costing-study tutorials and synthetic examples that connect NWAU outputs to NEP, NHCDC, AHPCS, and cost benchmarking workflows.
